I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from her own post in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and that a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note.

If her sheet needs a separate site code or address for Pine Crossing, I couldn't find one in #central-team or the shared files Pree can see. I told her that rather than guess. I only checked places Pree herself can see, and didn't use `search_messages`.
